title: North campus loop and print shop
caption: A walkable loop behind head office and a usable print shop with a saved island directory. The far northern island and other building interiors remain unfinished.

sections.title: North campus foot loop
sections.caption: Walk behind head office through the office streets and along the west-coast connection.

sections.title: Usable print shop
sections.caption: A furnished ground floor with presses, a proof counter, paper stock and a waiting chair.

sections.title: Print and keep the directory
sections.caption: Press the control, collect the output and read current venue locations. The saved paper can be reopened from the Bag.
